en.topic_title: China imposes travel curbs to protect ‘national security’ amid superpower tech race
en.topic_summary:
China imposed sweeping travel restrictions on its citizens on Tuesday, including exit bans on those deemed to endanger the country’s “industrial or technological security”.



File photo: Lukas Messmer/HKFP.



Citizens who violate technology import and export regulations could be banned from leaving China, the State Council said.
